meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline_en: Query and cross-analyze multiple bioinformatics databases through one unified interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bio databases in one consistent workflow

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能用统一的 Python 接口访问 40 多个生物信息学数据库和在线服务，例如查 UniProt 蛋白、分析 KEGG 通路、搜化合物，以及在不同数据库之间转换标识符。
howto.when: 当用户要求跨数据库查询、蛋白信息检索、通路分析、化合物搜索等生物信息学任务时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use a unified Python interface to access 40+ bioinformatics services and databases, e.g., query UniProt proteins, analyze KEGG pathways, search compounds, and convert identifiers between databases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for cross-database bioinformatics queries, protein retrieval, pathway analysis, compound search, or similar tasks.
